name: funwind
description: FunWind · 青翼字幕组（QYSUB）新论坛

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/web dev
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm db:build && docker compose -f docker/dev/compose.yaml up -d mailpit && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/db exec tsx scripts/e2e-reset.ts && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:bootstrap && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:seed && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:e2e-fixtures && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/web test:e2e && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/web test:e2e:prod
scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/migration migrate
scripts.verify:migration: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/migration verify
scripts.verify:all: pnpm check:secrets && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
